exchange_connections_limits_valid.name: exchange_connections_limits_valid
exchange_connections_limits_valid.value: ("exchange_connections"."approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("exchange_connections"."max_order_contracts" > 0 AND "exchange_connections"."max_order_notional_usdt" > 0 AND "exchange_connections"."max_exposure_usdt" >= "exchange_connections"."max_order_notional_usdt" AND "exchange_connections"."max_leverage" BETWEEN 1 AND 125)

exchange_connections_activation_needs_ap.name: exchange_connections_activation_needs_approval
exchange_connections_activation_needs_ap.value: "exchange_connections"."live_enabled" = false OR ("exchange_connections"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exchange_connections"."status" = 'VERIFIED')

order_blocks_trading_window_valid.name: order_blocks_trading_window_valid
order_blocks_trading_window_valid.value: ("order_blocks"."trading_window_start" IS NULL AND "order_blocks"."trading_window_end" IS NULL) OR ("order_blocks"."trading_window_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "order_blocks"."trading_window_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "order_blocks"."trading_window_start" <> "order_blocks"."trading_window_end")

order_intents_links.name: order_intents_links
order_intents_links.value: ("order_intents"."kind" = 'OPEN' AND "order_intents"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("order_intents"."kind" = 'CLOSE' AND "order_intents"."position_id" IS NOT NULL)
